M25-0104-P3 — A liminf over all indices does not justify sampling n=2mR — Counterevidence: Complete repaired proof preserves original definition and theorem.
M25-0104-P4 — Corollary3.8 selflessness assertion needs nontrivial G — Counterevidence: Scalar strict comparison true; all group-selfless applications infinite and unaffected.
Counterevidence: Actual Robert2012 source uses same closed-interval shorthand; an explicit zero convention can recover intended theorem.

M25-0104-P1 — Counterevidence: The nontrivial-product and strict-comparison conclusions are not disproved. The corrected Morse bound, conditional quadratic-T degree ledger, cyclic reduction and integer threshold repairs do not supply the missing continuous quasi-axis.

M25-0104-P2 — Counterevidence: The actual application has primitive a=y and does not use the false extra generality; the printed txt subgroup is genuinely free by the index-two kernel and u->uv automorphism. Louder-Magee maximal-abelian hypothesis excludes the counterexample.
M25-0104-P3 — Counterevidence: The original theorem under its original hypotheses survives this complete repair; theorem falsity not claimed.
M25-0104-P4 — Counterevidence: C has strict comparison and the examined group applications are nontrivial; no core strict-comparison consequence fails.
